definitions.explanation: The powdery residue left after burning.

notes:
{灰|はい} refers to the powdery residue left after burning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {灰|はい}を{捨|す}てる: to dispose of ashes
- {灰|はい}になる: to turn to ash, to be destroyed
- {灰|はい}にする: to reduce to ashes

COMPOUNDS:
- {灰皿|はいざら}: ashtray
- {灰色|はいいろ}: gray (ash color)
- {火山灰|かざんばい}: volcanic ash
- {石灰|せっかい}: lime (calcium oxide)
- {遺灰|いはい}: cremated remains, ashes

KANJI NOTE:
The reading changes in compounds: {灰|はい} alone, but often {~灰|~ばい} in compounds (e.g., {火山灰|かざんばい}).
